dog.description_text: My foster writes: I'm a sensitive loverboy who enjoys the company of people and cats. I love to play with wand and catnip toys and my sibling Stevie, and gaze at you sweetly and make air muffins when we are just hanging out. Puzzle toys and indoor bugs are no match for me. I adore snuggles, naps and pets with you - and even belly rubs when I'm feeling super comfy! I'm the first to explore a space and greet you at the door when you walk in, and like to follow you around. I'm a pro with the litter box and like to check in with all my companions to keep the emotional temperature nice and comfy at home. I'm very curious about plants and sometimes like to chew on things, so it's best to keep strings and things I shouldn't eat stowed where I can't reach them :)
dog.name: Charlie
